recordedDeviations: DanTerm clears pending wrap and open grapheme attachment on every recognized valid scroll/edit operation.
DanTerm pushes scrollback only for full-screen upward scrolls; bounded regions and line edits never retain vacated rows.
DanTerm retains default and indexed colors semantically instead of resolving libvterm palette RGB values.
Pinned libvterm lacks SGR 58/59 and mishandles 38:2::r:g:b; DanTerm deliberately consumes both correctly.
Raw ground-state C1 bytes and UTF-8 encodings beyond U+10FFFF are replaced by U+FFFD using maximal-subpart recovery.
DanTerm retains grapheme scalars exactly instead of truncating after five combining marks.
DanTerm follows VT500 string states: C0 is absorbed inside strings and BEL terminates only OSC.
DanTerm emits strict xterm legacy encodings where pinned libvterm emits unsolicited fixterms CSI-u for modified letters, Space, and Tab.
DanTerm reports DECRQM 0 for unsupported UTF-8 1005 and rxvt 1015 mouse encodings instead of libvterm's reset-state 2.

cases.rationale: state-mode.json re-establishes the vertical region and origin mode directly because the preceding DECSLRM case is out of scope.

cases.name: Origin mode without scroll region
cases.rationale: state-mode.json clears the margins and observes origin-mode homing at the full-screen origin.

cases.name: 79th Column
cases.rationale: state-wrapping.json retains the upstream 80-column geometry and observes the cursor before the right margin.

cases.name: 80th Column Phantom
cases.rationale: state-wrapping.json observes the pending-wrap cursor after the final column is filled.

cases.name: Line Wraparound
cases.rationale: state-wrapping.json observes the following glyph on a soft-wrapped row.

cases.name: Line Wraparound during combined write
cases.rationale: state-wrapping.json replays the combined write and asserts its two soft-wrap boundaries and cursor.

cases.name: DEC Auto Wrap Mode
cases.rationale: state-wrapping.json pins repeated overwrite at column 80 while autowrap is disabled.

cases.name: 80th column causes linefeed on wraparound
cases.rationale: state-wrapping-bottom.json retains the 80x25 geometry and observes the full-screen scrollback push.

cases.name: 80th column phantom linefeed phantom cancelled by explicit cursor move
cases.rationale: state-wrapping-bottom.json observes that CUP cancels pending wrap without another history push.

cases.name: Initial
cases.rationale: state-tabstops.json observes the default stops at columns 9 and 17.

cases.name: HTS
cases.rationale: state-tabstops.json installs and targets a custom stop at column 5.

cases.name: TBC 0
cases.rationale: state-tabstops.json clears only the selected default stop while retaining the custom and following stops.

cases.name: TBC 3
cases.rationale: state-tabstops.json clears all stops, installs one at column 50, and targets it from home.

cases.name: Tabstops after resize
cases.rationale: state-tabstops.json resets before growing to 100x30 and walks all twelve default stops.

cases.name: Set up state
cases.rationale: state-save.json establishes the upstream cursor position and bold pen through public state.

cases.name: Save
cases.rationale: state-save.json uses DEC private mode 1048 to snapshot the cursor and pen.

cases.name: Change state
cases.rationale: state-save.json asserts DECSCUSR's steady-underline appearance alongside the upstream cursor and pen changes.

cases.name: Restore
cases.rationale: state-save.json asserts restored cursor, pen, visibility, shape, and blink, adapting libvterm's blinking-block default to DanTerm's steady-block default.

cases.name: Save/restore using DECSC/DECRC
cases.rationale: state-save.json adopts the ESC aliases and asserts visibility, shape, and blink restoration.

cases.name: Save twice, restore twice happens on both edge transitions
cases.rationale: state-save.json pins single-slot overwrite and repeatable restore for position and explicitly selected appearance.

cases.name: DA
cases.rationale: state-query.json asserts the pinned primary DA reply byte-for-byte.

cases.name: XTVERSION
cases.rationale: Identity and version policy is deferred to Milestone 7.

cases.name: DSR
cases.rationale: state-query.json asserts the pinned operating-status reply byte-for-byte.

cases.name: CPR
cases.rationale: state-query.json asserts both pinned cursor-position replies byte-for-byte.

cases.name: DECCPR
cases.rationale: state-query.json asserts the pinned DEC-private cursor-position reply byte-for-byte.

cases.name: DECRQSS on DECSCUSR
cases.rationale: DCS-carried DECRQSS replies remain deferred because the parser absorbs DCS bodies.

cases.name: DECRQSS on SGR
cases.rationale: DCS-carried DECRQSS replies remain deferred because the parser absorbs DCS bodies.

cases.name: DECRQSS on SGR ANSI colours
cases.rationale: DCS-carried DECRQSS replies remain deferred because the parser absorbs DCS bodies.

cases.name: DECRQSS on SGR ANSI hi-bright colours
cases.rationale: DCS-carried DECRQSS replies remain deferred because the parser absorbs DCS bodies.

cases.name: DECRQSS on SGR 256-palette colours
cases.rationale: DCS-carried DECRQSS replies remain deferred because the parser absorbs DCS bodies.

cases.name: DECRQSS on SGR RGB8 colours
cases.rationale: DCS-carried DECRQSS replies remain deferred because the parser absorbs DCS bodies.

cases.name: S8C1T on DSR
cases.rationale: 8-bit C1 reply encoding is unsupported; ESC SP G remains an absorbed no-op.

cases.name: RIS homes cursor
cases.rationale: state-reset.json observes the cursor at the origin after RIS.

cases.name: RIS cancels scrolling region
cases.rationale: state-reset.json translates the scroll callback to the full-screen scrollback result after RIS.

cases.name: RIS erases screen
cases.rationale: state-reset-erase.json observes a blank viewport without a scrollback push.

cases.name: RIS clears tabstops
cases.rationale: state-reset.json observes RIS replacing a custom stop with the default column-9 stop.

cases.name: Placement
cases.rationale: Slices 1 and 2 already pin printing, absolute column movement, deferred wrap, and putglyph-equivalent placement more strongly through public cells.

cases.name: Resize
cases.rationale: Phase B adopts growth with cursor attachment through the neutral resize fixture seam.

cases.name: Resize without reset
cases.rationale: Phase B keeps existing content and cursor attachment across consecutive effective resizes.

cases.name: Resize shrink moves cursor
cases.rationale: DanTerm always reflows primary content, so phase B asserts the declared cell or padding anchor instead of libvterm's state-layer column clamp.

cases.name: Resize grow doesn't cancel phantom
cases.rationale: Phase B preserves the pending boundary anchor and places the next print at its reflowed location.

cases.name: Reset
cases.rationale: state-pen.json asserts semantic default colors rather than libvterm's resolved palette RGB values.

cases.name: Bold
cases.rationale: state-pen.json replays bold set, clear, and reset through the public current pen.

cases.name: Underline
cases.rationale: state-pen.json covers none, single, double, and curly underline values through the public current pen.

cases.name: Italic
cases.rationale: state-pen.json replays italic set, clear, and reset through the public current pen.

cases.name: Blink
cases.rationale: Blink is a declared contract omission and its SGR parameters are consumed without stored state.

cases.name: Reverse
cases.rationale: state-pen.json replays reverse set, clear, and reset through the public current pen.

cases.name: Font Selection
cases.rationale: Alternate font selection is a declared contract omission and its SGR parameters are consumed without stored state.

cases.name: Foreground
cases.rationale: state-pen.json adopts base, bright, indexed, RGB, and reset behavior while retaining colors semantically.

cases.name: Background
cases.rationale: state-pen.json adopts base, bright, indexed, RGB, and reset behavior while retaining colors semantically.

cases.name: Bold+ANSI colour == highbright
cases.rationale: Bold-to-highbright coupling belongs to renderer palette policy; engine bold and indexed colors remain independent.

cases.name: Super/Subscript
cases.rationale: Super/subscript presentation is a declared contract omission and its SGR parameters are consumed without stored state.

cases.name: DECSTR resets pen attributes
cases.rationale: state-pen.json replays DECSTR and observes the freshly reset public pen.

cases.name: REP no argument
cases.rationale: state-rep.json observes the default single repetition through viewport text and cursor state.

cases.name: REP zero (zero should be interpreted as one)
cases.rationale: state-rep.json observes zero normalized to one repetition.

cases.name: REP lowercase a times two
cases.rationale: state-rep.json observes two requested repetitions following the original glyph.

cases.name: REP with UTF-8 1 char
cases.rationale: state-rep.json repeats the complete UTF-8 scalar through the public viewport.

cases.name: REP with UTF-8 wide char
cases.rationale: state-rep.json observes each repeated fullwidth cluster advancing by two cells.

cases.name: REP with UTF-8 combining character
cases.rationale: state-rep.json observes the base and combining scalar repeated as one cluster.

cases.name: REP till end of line
cases.rationale: state-rep-edge.json retains the 80-column boundary, caps the huge count, and observes the following glyph after soft wrap.

cases.name: Spillover text marks continuation on second line
cases.rationale: flow-soft-wrap.json translates libvterm's continuation-row mark to DanTerm's continues-into-next-row flag.

cases.name: CRLF in column 80 does not mark continuation
cases.rationale: flow-hard-boundary.json reduces the dimensions while retaining the exact right-margin CRLF behavior.

cases.name: EL cancels continuation of following line
cases.rationale: flow-soft-wrap.json uses CUP because reverse index is not implemented, then asserts the equivalent hard-boundary projection.

cases.name: Get
cases.rationale: Earlier foundation suites pin public cell lookup and screen text projection.

cases.name: Erase
cases.rationale: Earlier erase suites pin screen clearing through public viewport and cell state.

cases.name: Copycell
cases.rationale: screen-copycell.json translates the ICH and DCH copy-cell events to public viewport assertions.

cases.name: Space padding
cases.rationale: Earlier foundation suites pin cursor-forward padding and public screen text.

cases.name: Linefeed padding
cases.rationale: Earlier foundation and scroll suites pin hard linefeed projection through public screen text.

cases.name: Altscreen
cases.rationale: screen-altscreen.json reproduces the upstream bytes and public screen assertions; libvterm's alternate-buffer opt-in has no DanTerm analog because the alternate screen is always available.

cases.name: Resize wider preserves cells
cases.rationale: Phase B asserts scalar-exact cells and logical text after growth.

cases.name: Resize wider allows print in new area
cases.rationale: Phase B verifies post-growth cursor placement and printing in the expanded grid.

cases.name: Resize shorter with blanks just truncates
cases.rationale: Phase B trims filler rows strictly below the cursor before any top-row displacement.

cases.name: Resize shorter with content must scroll
cases.rationale: Phase B translates callback order into exact oldest-first scrollback rows, including four blank hard lines.

cases.name: Resize shorter does not lose line with cursor
cases.rationale: Phase B retains the cursor row and displaces only rows required by the smaller viewport.

cases.name: Resize shorter does not send the cursor to a negative row
cases.rationale: DanTerm's declared D2 behavior clamps a displaced cursor to the top viewport row while preserving column and pending wrap.

cases.name: Resize taller attempts to pop scrollback
cases.rationale: Phase B pins no pull when the cursor is above the bottom and adds a native bottom-cursor case that does pull eligible history.

cases.name: Resize can operate on altscreen
cases.rationale: resize-altscreen.json reduces the dimensions while retaining the upstream reflow-off, no-scrollback-callback resize and both active-screen assertions.

cases.name: Plain
cases.rationale: screen-pen.json reduces dimensions and asserts default colors semantically on a plain cell.

cases.name: Bold
cases.rationale: screen-pen.json reduces dimensions and inspects bold on the written cell through public cell style.

cases.name: Italic
cases.rationale: screen-pen.json reduces dimensions and inspects cumulative bold and italic on the written cell.

cases.name: Underline
cases.rationale: screen-pen.json reduces dimensions and inspects cumulative bold, italic, and single underline on the written cell.

cases.name: Reset
cases.rationale: screen-pen.json reduces dimensions and verifies reset restores the default semantic cell style.

cases.name: Font
cases.rationale: Alternate font selection is a declared contract omission and its SGR parameters are consumed without stored state.

cases.name: Foreground
cases.rationale: screen-pen.json reduces dimensions and asserts the indexed foreground semantically instead of palette RGB.

cases.name: Background
cases.rationale: screen-pen.json reduces dimensions and asserts the indexed background semantically instead of palette RGB.

cases.name: Super/subscript
cases.rationale: Super/subscript presentation is a declared contract omission and its SGR parameters are consumed without stored state.

cases.name: EL sets only colours to end of line, not other attrs
cases.rationale: screen-pen.json reduces dimensions and pins BCE padding colors with reverse and other attributes cleared.

cases.name: DECSCNM xors reverse for entire screen
cases.rationale: DECSCNM is outside this slice's mode and terminal reset scope.

cases.name: Set default colours
cases.rationale: Configurable default palette colors belong to future renderer and theme policy.

cases.name: Unmodified ASCII
cases.rationale: state-input.json encodes normalized printable input as UTF-8.

cases.name: Ctrl modifier on ASCII letters
cases.rationale: DanTerm deliberately emits strict xterm control bytes without unsolicited CSI-u.

cases.name: Alt modifier on ASCII letters
cases.rationale: state-input.json pins the legacy ESC prefix.

cases.name: Ctrl-Alt modifier on ASCII letters
cases.rationale: DanTerm deliberately emits ESC plus the strict xterm control byte.

cases.name: Special handling of Ctrl-I
cases.rationale: DanTerm deliberately emits HT without unsolicited CSI-u.

cases.name: Special handling of Space
cases.rationale: DanTerm deliberately uses strict xterm plain, NUL, and ESC-prefixed forms.

cases.name: Cursor keys in reset (cursor) mode
cases.rationale: state-input.json pins normal CSI cursor bytes.

cases.name: Cursor keys in application mode
cases.rationale: state-input.json derives SS3 cursor bytes from replayed DECCKM state.

cases.name: Shift-Tab should be different
cases.rationale: DanTerm emits CSI Z while Kitty flag 1 owns enhanced modified-Tab reporting.

cases.name: Enter in linefeed mode
cases.rationale: state-input.json pins CR while LNM is reset.

cases.name: Enter in newline mode
cases.rationale: state-input.json derives CRLF from replayed LNM state.

cases.name: Unmodified F1 is SS3 P
cases.rationale: state-input.json pins the legacy SS3 function-key form.

cases.name: Modified F1 is CSI P
cases.rationale: state-input.json pins the xterm modifier parameter form.

cases.name: Keypad in DECKPNM
cases.rationale: state-input.json pins numeric keypad bytes.

cases.name: Keypad in DECKPAM
cases.rationale: state-input.json derives SS3 keypad bytes from replayed DECKPAM state.

cases.name: Bracketed paste mode off
cases.rationale: state-input.json applies DanTerm safe-paste normalization without markers.

cases.name: Bracketed paste mode on
cases.rationale: state-input.json wraps one sanitized body instead of separate start and end callbacks.

cases.name: Focus reporting disabled
cases.rationale: state-input.json pins disabled focus as silent.

cases.name: Focus reporting enabled
cases.rationale: state-input.json derives focus bytes from replayed mode state without property callbacks.

cases.name: Spillover text marks continuation on second line
cases.rationale: scrollback-pushline.json reduces dimensions and observes DanTerm's preceding-row wrap flag through public history.

cases.name: Continuation mark sent to sb_pushline
cases.rationale: scrollback-pushline.json replaces callback timing with exact retained cells and soft-wrap identity at each scroll-off boundary.

cases.name: Resize wider reflows wide lines
cases.rationale: Phase B adopts the wider reflow outcome and cursor attachment through public rows.

cases.name: Resize narrower can create continuation lines
cases.rationale: Phase B adopts narrower reflow with DanTerm's mechanically translated wrap flag.

cases.name: Shell wrapped prompt behaviour
cases.rationale: Phase B adopts the early widths and expects one-stream history reflow to pull the first prompt back at the final width.

cases.name: Cursor goes missing
cases.rationale: Sub-minimum requests become bit-identical no-ops under D6, while native two-column fixtures preserve the crash-regression intent.
